"""Actual frozen validator AST mutation checks; never runs its native/proof producers."""
import ast,copy,hashlib,json,re,sys,types
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
ROOT=Path('/Users/erik/.codex/worktrees/1598/umf');SELF=Path('/private/tmp/obligation-evidence-gate-astra-review.py')
if Path.cwd().resolve()!=ROOT or Path(__file__).resolve()!=SELF or len(sys.argv)!=1:raise RuntimeError('Unknown exact gate review invocation')
p=ROOT/'tools/security/validate-evidence.py';root=ROOT/'docs/helix/04-build/evidence/security'
pp=root/'obligation-source-correspondence-formal.json';rp=root/'owner-obligation-source-correspondence-astra-review.json';sp=root/'owner-semantic-coverage-astra-review.json'
out=root/'obligation-evidence-gate-astra-review.json';prior=out.read_bytes() if out.exists() else None
cp=ROOT/'tools/security/components.py';cr=root/'components.json';dr=root/'source-demands-validation.json'
frozen={str(q):q.read_bytes() for q in [SELF,p,pp,rp,sp,cp,cr,dr,Path(sys.executable).resolve()]};sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
raw=frozen[str(p)];tree=ast.parse(raw);proof=json.loads(frozen[str(pp)]);review=json.loads(frozen[str(rp)]);semantic=json.loads(frozen[str(sp)])
defs={n.name:n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)}
needed={'exact_libtest_counts','source_review_controls_valid'}
while True:
 following=needed|{n.id for name in needed for n in ast.walk(defs[name]) if isinstance(n,ast.Name) and n.id in defs}
 if following==needed:break
 needed=following
support=[n for n in tree.body if (isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in needed) or (isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id in ['source_test_names','semantic_tests'] for t in n.targets)) or (isinstance(n,ast.Expr) and isinstance(n.value,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.value.func,ast.Attribute) and isinstance(n.value.func.value,ast.Name) and n.value.func.value.id=='semantic_tests' and n.value.func.attr=='update')]
checks={}
for n in tree.body:
 if isinstance(n,ast.Expr) and isinstance(n.value,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.value.func,ast.Attribute) and isinstance(n.value.func.value,ast.Name) and n.value.func.value.id=='checks' and n.value.func.attr=='append':
  d=n.value.args[0]
  if isinstance(d,ast.Dict):
   for k,v in zip(d.keys,d.values):
    if isinstance(k,ast.Constant) and k.value=='id' and isinstance(v,ast.Constant) and v.value in ['conditional-obligation-source-correspondence-laws','independent-obligation-source-correspondence-review','owner-private-semantic-coverage-review']:checks[v.value]=d
assert len(checks)==3

def evaluate(a,b,c):
 env={'re':re,'json':json,'hashlib':hashlib,'root':root,'digest':lambda path:sha(frozen[str(path)])}
 exec(compile(ast.Module(body=support,type_ignores=[]),str(p),'exec'),env)
 env.update(source_proof=a,source_cases=a['cases'],source_laws={'exact-union-cannot-omit-required-source','scoped-field-identities-retain-scan-occurrence','key-component-position-is-not-a-set-of-fields','stored-and-context-identities-have-distinct-channels','source-correspondence-cannot-discharge-native-evidence'},source_review=b,source_runs=b['independentExecutions'],source_replay=b['formalReplay'],source_rows=b['formalReplay']['observations'],semantic_review=c,semantic_run=c['independentExecution'],semantic_stdout=c['independentExecution']['stdout'])
 env['source_expected']={case['id']+'/'+kind:(expected,sha(case[kind]['smt'].encode())) for case in a['cases'] for kind,expected in [('violation','unsat'),('negativeControl','sat'),('positivePopulation','sat')]}
 return {name:eval(compile(ast.Expression(body=node),str(p),'eval'),env)['status'] for name,node in checks.items()}
results=[]
def run(label,mutate,gate,wanted):
 a,b,c=copy.deepcopy((proof,review,semantic));mutate(a,b,c);observed=evaluate(a,b,c)[gate]
 results.append({'id':label,'gate':gate,'expected':wanted,'observed':observed})
 if observed!=wanted:raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(results[-1]))
for gate in checks:run('baseline-'+gate,lambda a,b,c:None,gate,'passed')
g='independent-obligation-source-correspondence-review'
run('raw-1118-count',lambda a,b,c:b['independentExecutions'][0].update(stdout=b['independentExecutions'][0]['stdout'].replace('118 passed','1118 passed')),g,'failed')
run('raw-filtered-count',lambda a,b,c:b['independentExecutions'][0].update(stdout=b['independentExecutions'][0]['stdout'].replace('0 filtered out','1 filtered out')),g,'failed')
run('wrong-formula-hash',lambda a,b,c:b['formalReplay']['observations'][0].update(smtSha256='0'*64),g,'failed')
run('duplicate-formula-id',lambda a,b,c:b['formalReplay']['observations'][0].update(id=b['formalReplay']['observations'][1]['id']),g,'failed')
run('wrong-formula-outcome',lambda a,b,c:b['formalReplay']['observations'][0].update(observed='sat'),g,'failed')
run('no-fresh-context',lambda a,b,c:b['formalReplay']['observations'][0].update(freshContext=False),g,'failed')
run('shrink-observations',lambda a,b,c:b.update(observations=b['observations'][:1]),g,'failed')
run('unrelated-observation',lambda a,b,c:b.update(observations=[{'id':'unrelated','expected':True,'observed':True}]),g,'failed')
run('missing-population-controls',lambda a,b,c:b['formalReplay'].update(concretePopulationControls=[]),g,'failed')
run('zero-position-population',lambda a,b,c:b['formalReplay']['concretePopulationControls'][0].update(expected={'position_i':0},observed={'position_i':0}),g,'failed')
run('duplicate-population-id',lambda a,b,c:b['formalReplay']['concretePopulationControls'][0].update(id=b['formalReplay']['concretePopulationControls'][1]['id']),g,'failed')
run('missing-source-test-line',lambda a,b,c:b['independentExecutions'][0].update(stdout=b['independentExecutions'][0]['stdout'].replace('test security_obligation_sources::tests::tuple_encoding_preserves_escaping_boundaries_and_exact_utf8_limits ... ok','')),g,'failed')
run('proof-foreign-law',lambda a,b,c:a['cases'][0].update(id='unrelated'),'conditional-obligation-source-correspondence-laws','failed')
run('proof-wrong-result',lambda a,b,c:a['cases'][0]['violation'].update(result='sat'),'conditional-obligation-source-correspondence-laws','failed')
g='owner-private-semantic-coverage-review'
run('semantic-summary119',lambda a,b,c:c['independentExecution'].update(stdout=c['independentExecution']['stdout'].replace('19 passed','119 passed')),g,'failed')
run('semantic-summaryfailed',lambda a,b,c:c['independentExecution'].update(stdout=c['independentExecution']['stdout'].replace('0 failed','1 failed')),g,'failed')
run('semantic-summaryignored',lambda a,b,c:c['independentExecution'].update(stdout=c['independentExecution']['stdout'].replace('0 ignored','1 ignored')),g,'failed')
run('semantic-summaryfiltered',lambda a,b,c:c['independentExecution'].update(stdout=c['independentExecution']['stdout'].replace('99 filtered out','100 filtered out')),g,'failed')
run('semantic-missingtest',lambda a,b,c:c['independentExecution'].update(stdout=c['independentExecution']['stdout'].replace('test security_semantic_coverage::tests::projected_sources_require_actual_complete_owner_inventory ... ok','')),g,'failed')
run('semantic-extrasummary',lambda a,b,c:c['independentExecution'].update(stdout=c['independentExecution']['stdout']+'\ntest result: ok. 19 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 99 filtered out; finished in 0.00s\n'),g,'failed')
semantic_new_names=re.findall(r'^test (security_semantic_coverage::tests::issued_source_demands_[^ ]+) \.\.\. ok$',semantic['independentExecution']['stdout'],re.M)
assert len(semantic_new_names)==4 and len(set(semantic_new_names))==4
for name in semantic_new_names:
 run('semantic-omit-'+name.rsplit('::',1)[-1],lambda a,b,c,name=name:c['independentExecution'].update(stdout=c['independentExecution']['stdout'].replace('test '+name+' ... ok','')),g,'failed')

# Evaluate the actual closed command gate with the frozen literal component manifest.
ct=ast.parse(frozen[str(cp)])
manifest_nodes=[n.value for n in ct.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='commands' for t in n.targets)]
assert len(manifest_nodes)==1
commands=ast.literal_eval(manifest_nodes[0]);assert len(commands)==72
component_gate=next(n.value.args[0] for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.Expr) and isinstance(n.value,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.value.func,ast.Attribute) and isinstance(n.value.func.value,ast.Name) and n.value.func.value.id=='checks' and n.value.func.attr=='append' and isinstance(n.value.args[0],ast.Dict) and any(isinstance(k,ast.Constant) and k.value=='id' and isinstance(v,ast.Constant) and v.value=='component-command-results' for k,v in zip(n.value.args[0].keys,n.value.args[0].values)))
component_receipt=json.loads(frozen[str(cr)])
def component_control(label,mutate,wanted):
 candidate=copy.deepcopy(component_receipt);mutate(candidate)
 env={'json':json,'component_commands':commands,'components_receipt':candidate,'component_runs':candidate.get('runs',[])}
 exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[defs['exact_json']],type_ignores=[]),str(p),'exec'),env)
 observed=eval(compile(ast.Expression(component_gate),str(p),'eval'),env)['status']
 results.append({'id':'component-'+label,'gate':'component-command-results','expected':wanted,'observed':observed})
 if observed!=wanted:raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(results[-1]))
component_control('baseline-72',lambda r:None,'passed')
for i in range(72):
 component_control('omit-command-'+str(i),lambda r,i=i:r['runs'].pop(i),'failed')
for i in range(71):
 def swap(r,i=i):r['runs'][i],r['runs'][i+1]=r['runs'][i+1],r['runs'][i]
 component_control('reorder-adjacent-'+str(i),swap,'failed')
component_control('duplicate-command',lambda r:r['runs'][0].update(command=r['runs'][1]['command']),'failed')
component_control('foreign-command',lambda r:r['runs'][0].update(command=['unrelated']),'failed')
for value,label in [(False,'false'),(0.0,'float-zero'),('0','string-zero'),(None,'null'),(1,'nonzero')]:
 component_control('exit-'+label,lambda r,value=value:r['runs'][0].update(exitCode=value),'failed')
for value,label in [(0,'integer-zero'),(None,'null'),(True,'true')]:
 component_control('timeout-'+label,lambda r,value=value:r['runs'][0].update(timedOut=value),'failed')
component_control('source-flag-integer-one',lambda r:r.update(sourcesUnchanged=1),'failed')
component_control('failed-status',lambda r:r.update(status='failed'),'failed')

# The main validator's child-gate composition is exercised without executing its subprocess.
demand_nodes=[n for n in tree.body if (isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id in {'source_demand_ids','source_demand_closed'} for t in n.targets)) or (isinstance(n,ast.For) and isinstance(n.iter,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.iter.func,ast.Name) and n.iter.func.id=='enumerate' and any(isinstance(x,ast.Name) and x.id=='source_demand_ids' for x in n.iter.args))]
assert len(demand_nodes)==3
demand_receipt=json.loads(frozen[str(dr)])
def demand_control(label,mutate,wanted,exit_code=0):
 candidate=copy.deepcopy(demand_receipt);mutate(candidate)
 env={'source_demand_run':types.SimpleNamespace(returncode=exit_code),'source_demand_gate':candidate,'checks':[]}
 exec(compile(ast.Module(body=demand_nodes,type_ignores=[]),str(p),'exec'),env)
 observed='passed' if len(env['checks'])==5 and all(c['status']=='passed' for c in env['checks']) else 'failed'
 results.append({'id':'source-demand-main-'+label,'gate':'source-demand-five-check-composition','expected':wanted,'observed':observed})
 if observed!=wanted:raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(results[-1]))
demand_control('baseline',lambda r:None,'passed')
demand_control('subprocess-failure',lambda r:None,'failed',1)
for i in range(5):
 demand_control('missing-check-'+str(i),lambda r,i=i:r['checks'].pop(i),'failed')
 demand_control('failed-check-'+str(i),lambda r,i=i:r['checks'][i].update(status='failed'),'failed')
demand_control('foreign-check',lambda r:r['checks'][0].update(id='unrelated'),'failed')
demand_control('duplicate-check',lambda r:r['checks'][0].update(id=r['checks'][1]['id']),'failed')
demand_control('native-promotion',lambda r:r.update(nativeImplementationQualified=True),'failed')
demand_control('acceptance-promotion',lambda r:r.update(acceptanceCasesPromoted=['US-056-AC7']),'failed')
if any(Path(path).read_bytes()!=data for path,data in frozen.items()):raise RuntimeError('Captured input changed')
if (out.read_bytes() if out.exists() else None)!=prior:raise RuntimeError('Prior review changed')
receipt={'id':'obligation-evidence-gate-astra-review','status':'qualified-evidence-gate-review-passed','reviewer':'/root/astra_security_review','generatedAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'sourceDigests':{path:sha(data) for path,data in frozen.items()},'sourcesUnchanged':True,'reviewCommand':{'argv':[sys.executable,str(SELF)],'cwd':str(ROOT),'sourceSha256':sha(frozen[str(SELF)]),'source':frozen[str(SELF)].decode()},'observations':results,'remainingFindings':[],'scope':'Actual in-memory evaluation of three source/formal/semantic review expressions and their helpers, the exact ordered 72-command component gate, and the five-check source-demand child composition from frozen validate-evidence.py AST. Baselines use the frozen current review and execution receipts; the component command authority is independently literal-evaluated from frozen components.py. Every command omission and adjacent reordering is checked, with duplicate, substitution and typed exit/timeout controls. Mutants alter copies only; no reviewed receipt, Rust source, Cargo target or native state is modified. This checks the named gate rejection behavior, not general validator completeness or receipt authentication. Python interpreter bytes are captured; standard-library/platform runtime remains a trusted premise. No producer, Cargo, native acquisition, authorization or acceptance promotion. Current review bodies and formula custody were independently verified in their separately retained scope; this is not another proof replay.','acceptanceCriteria':['US-056-AC7','US-056-AC10'],'nativeImplementationQualified':False,'acceptanceCasesPromoted':[]}
if prior is not None:
 h=sha(prior);archive=out.with_name(out.stem+'-prior-'+h[:16]+'.json')
 if archive.exists() and archive.read_bytes()!=prior:raise RuntimeError('Archive collision')
 if not archive.exists():archive.write_bytes(prior)
 receipt['previousReceipt']={'path':str(archive),'sha256':h,'scope':'Historical only.'}
out.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'status':receipt['status'],'controls':len(results),'sourcePins':len(frozen),'sourcesUnchanged':True,'sha256':sha(out.read_bytes()),'output':str(out)}))
